name: A Cup of Hot Tea
desc: Keep an enemy piece at the tea table: Freeze it for 2 turns.

name: "Closed" Sign
desc: Put barriers on two empty squares for 2 turns.

name: Book from the Outside World
desc: Give one of your bishops, rooks or queens Leap.

name: Warding Charm
desc: Ward one of your pieces for 2 turns.

name: Kourindou Appraisal
desc: Read the name and use of a card your opponent played this game, and play that very card. It works on Ultimate Cards too.

name: Ice Sign "Icicle Fall"
desc: Drop icicles down a file: Freeze every enemy piece on it for 3 turns.

name: Freeze Sign "Minus K"
desc: Freeze one enemy piece for 3 turns.

name: Freeze Sign "Freeze Atmosphere"
desc: Freeze the very air and ice over the board: every enemy bishop, rook and queen stands on Ice for 3 turns.

name: Snow Sign "Diamond Blizzard"
desc: Freeze every enemy piece in the 3×3 around a square for 2 turns.

name: Freeze Sign "Perfect Freeze"
desc: Freeze every enemy piece except the king for 2 turns.

name: Dream Sign "Duplex Barrier"
desc: Put a barrier on two empty squares for 3 turns.

name: Dream Sign "Evil-Sealing Circle"
desc: Seal away every effect your opponent cast: Freeze, Disarm, Ice and Fate on your pieces end, and so do their Wards, Barriers, Counters and Phantoms.

name: Treasure "Yin-Yang Orb of the Demon God"
desc: Ward two of your pieces for 2 turns.

name: Spirit Sign "Fantasy Seal"
desc: Seal away an enemy knight, bishop or pawn.

name: "Fantasy Heaven"
desc: Ward all your pieces except the king for 2 turns.

name: Magic Sign "Stardust Reverie"
desc: Remove an enemy pawn.

name: Star Sign "Escape Velocity"
desc: One of your pawns flies up to three squares straight ahead. It cannot pass a blocked square and stops short of the rank before promotion.

name: Comet "Blazing Star"
desc: One of your bishops, rooks or queens dashes along a line as far as it can, blowing away every enemy pawn in its path. There must be an enemy pawn in the way.

name: Love Sign "Master Spark"
desc: Sweep a file: remove every enemy knight, bishop and pawn on it.

name: Magicannon "Final Spark"
desc: Sweep a file: remove every enemy piece on it but the king.

name: Puppeteer Sign "Maiden's Bunraku"
desc: Swap two of your pieces.

name: War Command "Dolls' War"
desc: Your pawns on the chosen file and the files on either side march one square forward. Pawns that are blocked or would reach the rank before promotion stay put, and the pawns that marched cannot capture this turn.

name: Battle Sign "Little Legion"
desc: Summon two of your captured pawns.

name: Magic Sign "Artful Sacrifice"
desc: Blow up one of your pawns, removing every enemy knight, bishop and pawn on the 8 squares around it.

name: "Phantom of the Grand Guignol"
desc: Take an enemy knight or bishop on your strings: it becomes yours.

name: Human Sign "Slash of Present"
desc: Choose one of your knights, bishops or rooks. If it cuts down an enemy piece this turn, it moves once more (a move that captures nothing). If the cut gives check, it ends there.

name: Soul Sign "Wheel of Pain of the Living and the Dead"
desc: Create a Phantom of one of your knights, bishops or rooks on an empty square next to it. The phantom vanishes after 2 turns.

name: Hell Realm Sword "Two Hundred Yojana in One Slash"
desc: Give one of your bishops, rooks or queens Pierce.

name: "Matsuyoi-Reflecting Satellite Slash"
desc: One of your pieces takes a Counter stance for 3 turns.

name: Human Ghost "Future Eternity Slash"
desc: Choose one of your pieces. If it cuts down an enemy piece this turn, it keeps cutting with further captures, up to three in all. If a cut gives check, it ends there.

name: Wood Sign "Sylphy Horn"
desc: A gust pushes every enemy pawn one square back. Pawns on their starting rank or blocked behind stay put.

name: Earth Sign "Rage Trilithon"
desc: Put a barrier on three empty squares for 3 turns.

name: Water Sign "Princess Undine"
desc: Wash an enemy knight, bishop, rook or queen back to an empty square on its own back rank.

name: Fire Sign "Agni Shine"
desc: Burn away one enemy piece other than the king or queen.

name: Fire Water Wood Metal Earth Sign "Philosopher's Stone"
desc: Turn one of your pawns into a queen.

name: Conjuring "Misdirection"
desc: Move one of your pieces (not the king or a pawn) to an empty square on your half of the board.

name: Time Sign "Private Square"
desc: Stop time for two enemy pieces: Freeze them for 2 turns.

name: Maid Secret Skill "Killing Doll"
desc: Pin two enemy pieces with knives: Disarm them for 2 turns.

name: Watch "Luna Dial"
desc: Turn the hands back: your opponent's last move never happened. A piece of yours it captured comes back, and the Spirit that move gave is taken away again.

name: Illusion World "The World"
desc: Time Stop: make two moves in a row this turn.

name: Scarlet Devil "Scarlet Devil"
desc: Freeze every enemy pawn for 2 turns.

name: Divine Arts "Vampiric Illusion"
desc: Make an enemy pawn your thrall: it becomes your pawn.

name: Curse "Vlad Tepes's Curse"
desc: Freeze an enemy rook or queen for 3 turns.

name: Destiny "Miserable Fate"
desc: Brand two enemy pieces with Fate for 3 turns.

name: Divine Spear "Spear the Gungnir"
desc: Pierce and remove any enemy piece but the king.

name: Boundary Sign "Quadruple Barrier"
desc: Put a barrier on the empty squares of a 2×2 block for 3 turns.

name: Shikigami "Ran Yakumo"
desc: Move one of your knights, bishops or rooks to any empty square. It stays under Freeze until the end of your next turn.

name: Barrier "Boundary of Life and Death"
desc: Return your most valuable captured piece (not a queen) to your back rank. A pawn returns to the rank in front of it.

name: Boundary Sign "Boundary of Wave and Particle"
desc: Swap one of your pieces with an enemy piece of the same kind. Not the kings.

name: Yukari's Arcanum "Danmaku Bounded Field"
desc: Put a barrier on every empty square around the enemy king for 2 turns.
